description: Runs ONE niche on the signed-in account: starts the video, puts the aicut card in front of the user and returns the new job's id immediately. It does NOT wait for the video. WHEN: the user wants one of the formats `list_niches` lists. Read that niche in full first: `slug` and `revision` come from it, `values` answer its text and select inputs by `key`, `media` fills its image inputs. A setting you leave out is the niche's default. THE CARD: this call already opened the aicut card: do not call `show_generation` for this job. WAIT: `wait_for_generation` (this id, `media`), again at once while `terminal: false`, then one short line; no `get_*` polling, timers, background shells or narrating the wait. No card? Give the user the `url`. TIMING: a video takes 1-3 minutes, up to about 6: do not assume it failed before then. COST: this spends the user's tokens. A 409 `revision_changed` means the niche or its price moved: read it again and ask again at the new price. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, ask in the SAME message as the price, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES, this server's instructions). IDEMPOTENCY: a reused `idempotency_key` REPLAYS the first job whatever the settings: never reuse one for a new generation (this server's instructions). The flow: `get_recipe` `niche-run`.

aspect_ratio.description: A `settings.options.aspect_ratios` value. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

audio.description: Sound on the video, where `settings.options.audio_selectable` is true. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

duration_seconds.description: One of the niche's `settings.options.durations_seconds`; longer costs more. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

input.description: The `key` of the image input this fills.

source.description: `preset` (give `index`), `mine` (an account image: `id`) or `url` (a public https image address or a `confirm_upload` url).

model.description: A `settings.options.models` value. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

resolution.description: One of the niche's `settings.options.resolutions`; higher costs more. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

revision.description: The `revision` of the niche as you read it (`list_niches` with `slug`).

values.description: Answers to the text and select inputs, by input `key`: the user's own words, or a select's `options` value (own words only where `allow_custom`).

name: generate_from_niche
title: Make a video from a niche
